title: Interview for a hotel job
instructions: Kemal bir otelde resepsiyonist işi için görüşmede. Uzun bir diyalog; deneyimi, çalışma koşullarını ve maaşı takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: manager
script.text: Thank you for coming, Kemal. Can you tell me about your experience?

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: Yes. I worked in a café for two years, and then in a small hotel in Antalya for one summer.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: Turkish, English and a little German. I'm learning Russian at the moment.

script.speaker: manager
script.text: That's useful. We have a lot of Russian guests. Can you work at night?

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: Yes, I don't mind night shifts. But I can't work on Sundays because I have classes.

script.speaker: manager
script.text: That's OK. The job is five days a week, eight hours a day. Some weeks you work in the morning, some weeks at night.

script.speaker: manager
script.text: Eighteen hundred pounds a month. Night shifts pay more. And you get free meals at the hotel.

script.speaker: kemal
script.text: That sounds great. When would I start?

script.speaker: manager
script.text: On the first of June. We'll call you by Friday with our decision.

questions.prompt: Where did Kemal work for one summer?
options: in a small hotel in Antalya
in a big hotel in Istanbul
questions.feedback: Bir yaz Antalya'da küçük bir otelde çalıştı. İki yıl kafedeydi.
